verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch's CLI can run entire collections of API tests/requests in one command (hopp test) and the MCP server lets an agent read/change collections, requests, environments, and teams programmatically, which supports batch-style automation across many items. However, there's no explicit documentation of true bulk operations (e.g., bulk edit/delete/tag many requests at once, batch import/export at scale) beyond running a collection. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-edit/bulk-delete/bulk-tag capability across many items, evidence of bulk operations via MCP/CLI beyond collection execution, and independent hands-on confirmation of large-scale batch actions.
